info.title: Nexora API
info.description: Versioned REST API for the Nexora Unified Business Operating Platform. All business resources are tenant-scoped and protected by RBAC.

Operational metrics for API, jobs, integrations, AI and authentication events

get.summary: Get current user, workspace context and permissions
Load all authorised workspace data for the web client
List businesses visible to the current tenant

post.summary: Resend an employee invitation with a fresh temporary password
Add an internal note to a conversation

Send a message through a channel adapter
Merge a duplicate customer into this one (idempotent with Idempotency-Key)
